title: agrostis stolonifera subsp. albida
intro: Agrostis stolonifera subsp. albida, commonly known as White Creeping Bentgrass, is a subspecies of grass native to the Northern Hemisphere, characterized by its white or pale green leaves and creeping stems. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help alleviate various health conditions such as arthritis, digestive issues, and skin irritations. The therapeutic actions of White Creeping Bentgrass include soothing, calming, and protecting the skin, making it a potential natural remedy for wounds and skin conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other plant compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties.
